name: CI Pipeline
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, dev ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, dev ]
jobs:
  # ========================================= #
  # FASE 1: INTEGRACIÓN - Test for backends #
  # ========================================= #
  ms-asign-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./apps/backend/ms-asignaturas
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: config JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          chache: maven
  ms-estud-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./apps/backend/ms-estudiantes
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: config JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          chache: maven
  ms-notas-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./apps/backend/ms-notas
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: config JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          chache: maven
  ms-usuarios-auth-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./apps/backend/ms-asignaturas
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: config JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '21'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          chache: maven
